name: Long request error
justification: Section 'Requests' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires server rejection of requests exceeding 1024 bytes.

name: Invalid url
justification: Section 'Requests' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires that a Gemini request line have the form 'absolute-URI CRLF', where the scheme used in the URI is 'gemini' (gemini-lite for our project). A client given an invalid URL such as invalid_url.

name: Basic input handling
justification: Section 'Status codes/Input expected' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires servers to respond with status 10 when needing client input via a prompt, so a client must receive the prompt, collect user input, append it URI-encoded as a query, and expect a success status 20 response.

name: Sensitive input handling
justification: Section 'Status codes/Input expected' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi defines status 11 as a request for sensitive input such as passwords.

name: Handle correct service of nested directories
justification: As specified in the project manual, the server must be able to serve nested directories like /tmp/docroot/files/index.gmi.

name: Serve plain text file
justification: Section 'Responses' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires servers to serve files with their correct MIME type such as text/plain or text/gemini.

name: File not found
justification: Section 'Status code/Permanent failure' of the Gemini protocol specification at https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires servers to respond with status 51 (Not Found) when a requested resource does not exist on the server.

name: Request contains URL-encoded characters
justification: Section 'Requests' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi states that the request URI must be a valid absolute URL, which includes percent-encoded characters representing characters in the path. In this case, the server responds with status code 51 because the resource does not exist.

name: Proxy request refused

server_transactions.reply: 50 Proxy should not contact the server

reply_regex: ^50 Proxy should not contact the server$
justification: Section Status codes/Permanent failure' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires proxy servers to respond with status 53 (Proxy request refused) when refusing a request for a domain not served by the server and when the server does not accept proxy requests.

name: Proxy error

server_transactions.reply: 43 With great power comes great responsibility

reply_regex: ^43 With great power comes great responsibility$
justification: Section 'Status codes/Temporary failure' of https://geminiprotocol.net/docs/protocol-specification.gmi requires proxy servers to forward upstream server errors without modification when the server was unable to successfully complete a transaction with the remote host.
